summary: Biggs told Stew Peters to 'keep preaching' after Peters called for the 'final solution' of American Jews, and co-signed a 2024 letter to Biden denouncing the administration's abstention on a UN Gaza ceasefire resolution, calling an immediate ceasefire a way to let Hamas regroup. His 2017 House statement that he 'unequivocally stands with Israel' and his characterization of Hamas as 'pro-genocide' complete a consistent pro-Israel record. His Nay on the Antisemitism Awareness Act was framed on constitutional grounds, not as a Palestinian-justice position.
